meta.description: Get to know UAMOTORS: the multidisciplinary UAM team designing, manufacturing, and validating a Formula-style single-seater to compete in Formula SAE.

text1: UAMOTORS is a multidisciplinary student team from the Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana, founded at Unidad Azcapotzalco in March 2025 by student initiative. We are more than an engineering group; we integrate knowledge from our unit's three academic divisions: CBI (Basic Sciences and Engineering), CSH (Social Sciences and Humanities), and CAD (Sciences and Arts for Design).
text2: Our core purpose is to tackle real-world technological development challenges through the design and construction of a Formula-style race car that complies with Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) guidelines.

mision.title: Our Mission
mision.text: We aim to generate a profound educational impact on every member by establishing strategic partnerships with the industry that strengthen technological development in Mexico.

vision.title: Design Vision
vision.text: Our focus is on building a reliable, cost-effective single-seater optimized for novice drivers, prioritizing manufacturable designs and decisions backed by technical criteria.

objetivos.text: To establish UAMOTORS as a benchmark, we work toward clear milestones:

objetivo1.title: Technical Inspection Approval:
objetivo1.text: Clearing technical inspection under SAE regulations, aiming for every new design to fully satisfy competition safety and rulebook standards.

objetivo2.title: Top 3 in FSAE Mexico 2027:
objetivo2.text: Building on our 2026 Top 5 finish, targeting the national podium in 2027 among Mexico's top three collegiate racing teams.

objetivo3.title: Manufacturing & Cost Efficiency:
objetivo3.text: Leveraging our 3rd-place podium in the 2026 Cost Event to deliver a competitive, cost-effective car optimized for real-world manufacturing.
